description: Ring Constant Client is being designed around the Lean consensus specification rather than implementing only a standalone basic client
ZK-Lean is being developed as a Lean 4 framework for formally verifying the correctness of ZK statements
Circuit verification should be designed around soundness and completeness by construction, rather than relying only on post-hoc verification
For complex trace data structures, the formal proof layer will use an abstract specification interface so the efficient implementation can be developed independently
AI/LLM-assisted formalization is being used as a practical workflow for generating and testing candidate proofs, with humans and theorem provers validating the results
The longer-term direction is proof-producing verification rather than putting the verification tooling itself inside the trusted code base
